title: Md Code Highlight Escaping
note: md-code-fenced-escaping pins escaping in an unhighlighted block; this one pins it inside a colored span, where the text is escaped after the span is opened and the `<`, `>`, `&` and `"` must never reach the markup raw. The string literal holds all four, and the comment holds a `` that would close the span it sits in if it were not escaped. The HTML block additionally puts markup inside markup: MARKUP_TAG_* spans around tag delimiters that are themselves escaped entities.
